title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add more units to the Session 1 converter (temperature excluded)
body:
## Problem
The converter knows only a few length and speed units.

## Context
Students want mass, time and area units too. Temperature needs an offset, not only a factor, so leave it out.

## Expected outcome
A `MASS` and a `TIME` table in `lesson.py` with exact definitions (pound 0.45359237 kg) and checkpoint tests.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/checkpoint.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least 4 new units with exact factors
- [ ] Round-trip checks added to the checkpoint

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: parse compound unit strings
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's first milestone does not exist yet; the wrapper only knows fixed unit names.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. A parser turns 'kN' or 'mm/s^2' into a size and a dimension.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and parses 20 unit strings
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a unit-aware file reader
body:
## Problem
The Mars Climate Orbiter story is about data passed between programs; the repo has no example of a file with units.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 2.

## Expected outcome
A reader for a small CSV with a unit header that returns Quantity objects and refuses bad files.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 2 good files accepted, 3 faulty files rejected
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: a transfer orbit with a unit mistake
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a miss growing on a toy Earth-to-Mars cruise; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Miss within 5 percent of 250 km for the stated toy numbers
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
